constructor.details: The quote token must report exactly six decimals; the wrapper and quote token must contain deployed code.      Deployment tooling must supply and verify the target chain's official USDC address because the constructor      cannot prove token identity from metadata.

params.protocolTreasury_: Immutable protocol-fee recipient used by every raffle.
params.quoteToken_: Target chain's official six-decimal USDC contract trusted by every raffle.
params.vrfWrapper_: Official Chainlink VRF v2.5 native direct-funding wrapper for the target chain.

params.params: Sponsor-selected recipient, prize, reserve, and timing configuration.

returns.raffle: Address of the newly created and activated clone.

callbackGasLimit().notice: Returns the fixed Chainlink callback execution limit used by every raffle.

constructor.notice: Deploys the ownerless factory and its locked raffle implementation with one immutable configuration.

createRaffle((address,address,uint256,ui.notice: Creates, initializes, registers, and funds one autonomous fixed-target raffle clone atomically.

idByRaffle(address).notice: Returns the canonical identifier assigned to a raffle address.

isRaffle(address).notice: Returns whether an address is a raffle registered by this factory.

protocolTreasury().notice: Returns the immutable recipient of protocol fees from every raffle.

quoteToken().notice: Returns the immutable canonical six-decimal USDC contract used by every raffle.

raffleById(uint256).notice: Returns the canonical raffle address for an identifier.

raffleCount().notice: Returns the lifetime number of successfully created raffles.

raffleImplementation().notice: Returns the immutable implementation targeted by every registered ERC-1167 clone.

requestConfirmations().notice: Returns the fixed Chainlink confirmation count used by every raffle.

vrfWrapper().notice: Returns the immutable Chainlink VRF v2.5 native direct-funding wrapper used by every raffle.
